notes: Step 5 misstates Moser’s result: any solution with p>1 must have even p. For odd p, pairing terms modulo k gives 2∑j^p ≡ 0, whereas the equation gives 2∑j^p ≡ 2, so k divides 2; neither k=1 nor k=2 works for p>1. The draft also leaves the requested uniqueness unproved. It does not use the documented false Bernoulli identity.
